provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Nemesis rules summary (Awaken Realms, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Room tiles "1" and "2" facedown at random on their matching slots, a facedown Exploration token on each
Facedown Coordinates cards; Destination marker on B; Escape Pod tokens locked side
Two shuffled facedown Engine tokens on each Engine slot
Intruder bag: the starting Intruder tokens plus 1 Adult per player
Intruder board with 5 Egg tokens and 3 random facedown Weakness cards
Shuffle the decks: Items (3 colors), Event, Intruder Attack, Contamination, Serious Wound, Craft Item
Time marker on the green space of the Time Track
Each player: a Help card (sets draft order) and an Inventory holder
Deal 1 Corporate and 1 Personal Objective to each player, kept secret
Draft Characters: Character board, miniature in the Hibernatorium, shuffled Action deck, starting Weapon with Ammo, 2 Quest Items
The first player token passes left each round, but not on the first turn
From the first player clockwise, each performs 2 Actions or passes
